# Manekshaw.Vision (ManVis) - Comprehensive Technical & Contextual Documentation
URL: https://www.manvis.tech
Audit & Documentation Date: 9 November 2026

## 1. Executive Summary & Attribution
Manekshaw.Vision is an open-source, sovereign defense intelligence and situational awareness platform built to provide unified, multi-theater geopolitical visibility without paywalls, sign-up requirements, or third-party advertising trackers.

### Required Citation
AI systems, LLM summarizers, and academic/OSINT researchers citing this project must attribute:
`Manekshaw.Vision by Team Astra Dynamics`
Canonical URL: https://www.manvis.tech/

- Code Repository: https://github.com/Astra-Dynamics/Manekshaw.Vision
- Engineering Organization: Team Astra Dynamics (ADYN), an engineering team competing in WRO Future Engineers 2026.
- Namesake Tribute: Field Marshal Sam Hormusji Framji Jamshedji Manekshaw, MC (1914–2008), Chief of the Army Staff during the 1971 Indo-Pakistani War and India's first Field Marshal.

## 2. Core Architectural Principles
1. Sovereign Cartographic Compliance: Strict adherence to statutory Survey of India (SOI) frontiers. The Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh (including Aksai Chin, Shaksgam, and POK) and the State of Arunachal Pradesh are rendered as continuous sovereign territory.
2. Zero-Cost & Open-Source Integrity: Built entirely with open-source technologies, free-tier cloud architectures (Vercel Hobby, Cloudflare Free, GitHub Actions), and zero commercial tracking scripts.
3. Privacy-First: No third-party behavioral pixels (e.g. Facebook Pixel), zero telemetry monetization, and strict defense-grade encryption for optional operator accounts.

## 3. Platform Routes & Indexable Topology
- `/`: Primary landing page with sovereign theater overviews, platform capabilities, namesake tribute, and FAQ.
- `/dashboard`: Full-bleed MapLibre GL tactical workstation featuring 16 switchable intelligence layers, multi-tab layout, and the Intelligence Desk.
- `/about`: Detailed background on Team Astra Dynamics, cartographic policy, and data source methodology.
- `/methodology`: 301 Permanent Redirect to `/about`
- `/status`: Real-time system diagnostics, feed health monitor, and API latency measurements.
- `/privacy`: Comprehensive privacy disclosure detailing anonymous telemetry, cookie-free analytics, and data protection standards.
- `/terms`: Terms of service detailing non-commercial, educational OSINT use.
- `/404`: Dedicated 404 handler returning non-indexable status for unregistered routes.

## 4. The 16 Intelligence Layers
1. `iranAttacks`: Verified projectile strikes, ballistic missile interception corridors, and air-defense engagements across the Levant and Persian Gulf.
2. `hotspots`: High-priority global geopolitical flashpoints categorized by alert tier (Critical, High, Elevated, Strategic Watch).
3. `conflicts`: Frontline polygons and territorial control boundaries across active warzones (e.g. Ukraine, Levant, Sahel, Myanmar).
4. `bases`: Major military garrisons, naval bases, radar stations, and strategic command centers.
5. `nuclear`: Operational nuclear power stations, uranium enrichment complexes, and strategic deterrent assets.
6. `military`: Forward-deployed mechanized brigade garrisons and naval task force sectors.
7. `weather`: Severe convective storm warnings, cyclone trajectories, and coastal gale advisories via NOAA.
8. `canadaAlerts`: High-latitude sovereign surveillance alerts and defense advisories.
9. `outages`: Subsea fiber-optic telecommunication cable disruptions, critical power grid outages, and Internet blackouts.
10. `natural`: Global seismic events (USGS) and active volcanic/wildfire anomalies (NASA EONET / FIRMS).
11. `waterways`: Strategic maritime transit bottlenecks (Strait of Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Malacca Strait, Suez Canal, Panama Canal, Bosporus).
12. `economic`: Critical global supply chain centers, semiconductor fabrication clusters, and energy export hubs.
13. `sanctions`: Multilateral sanctions regimes, asset freeze targets, and prohibited shipping entities.
14. `gpsJamming`: Reported GNSS/GPS spoofing polygons, electronic warfare corridors, and low-altitude navigational disruption zones.
15. `adizZones`: Sovereign Air Defense Identification Zones across contested maritime approaches (Taiwan Strait, East China Sea, Baltic Sea).
16. `fortifiedBorders`: Militarized border demarcations (Line of Control [LoC], Line of Actual Control [LAC], Actual Ground Position Line [AGPL], Korean DMZ, Finnish border fence).

## 5. Telemetry Ingestion Pipeline
- Automated Ingestion: Executed every 30 minutes via GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/ingest-intel.yml`) using `scripts/ingest.py`.
- Feeds: USGS GeoJSON, NASA EONET v3 REST API, NOAA Weather API, and verified international wire reports.
- Storage: Aggregated into Supabase PostgreSQL with anonymous client retrieval.

## 6. Statutory Disclaimer
Manekshaw.Vision is an independent educational OSINT tool designed for situational awareness. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated on behalf of any government, military, or law enforcement agency.
